navigation.purpose: Small regular links with wide spacing.

motion.name: customer-enter

motion.name: ticket-reveal
motion.purpose: Clip reveal when a ticket first appears.

motion.name: ingredient-drop
motion.purpose: A bounded ingredient drop into the bowl.

components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; min-height:48px; padding:10px 5px; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); border-radius:0; color:var(--ink, #080808); background:transparent; font-family:var(--font, 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif); font-weight:500; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; letter-spacing:.065em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity:.6; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.35; cursor:default; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-btn-primary .ds-icon { width:22px; height:22px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A supporting action with a lighter rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; min-height:48px; padding:10px 5px; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); border-radius:0; color:var(--ink, #080808); background:transparent; font-family:var(--font, 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif); font-weight:500; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; letter-spacing:.065em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity:.6; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity:.35; cursor:default; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-btn-secondary .ds-icon { width:22px; height:22px; } .ds-btn-secondary { border-bottom:1px solid #999; }

components.name: Station Navigation
components.description: Five drawing-and-label actions with a short ink active mark.
components.css: .ds-station-nav { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr); padding:12px 14px; border-top:1px solid var(--line, #e6e6e6); background:var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-station-tab { min-width:0; min-height:55px; padding:6px 2px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:none; color:var(--grey, #666); font-family:var(--font, 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif); font-size:11px; line-height:1.7; letter-spacing:.045em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab-icon { display:flex; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-tab-icon .ds-icon { width:23px; height:23px; stroke-width:1.65; } .ds-station-tab.ds-active { color:var(--ink, #080808); } .ds-station-tab.ds-active::after { content:''; display:block; width:20px; height:2px; margin:6px auto 0; background:var(--ink, #080808); transform:rotate(-2deg); } .ds-station-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Share Field
components.description: The observed read-only fallback for copying a game URL.
components.css: .ds-share-field { width:100%; min-height:48px; padding:.7rem; border:2px solid var(--line, #e6e6e6); border-radius:12px; color:var(--ink, #080808); font-family:var(--font, 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif); font-size:14px; line-height:1.7; letter-spacing:.025em; } .ds-share-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Recipe Ingredient
components.description: Inline required ingredient with an explicit completion check.
components.html: Flour
components.css: .ds-recipe-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 0; font-family:var(--font, 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif); font-size:10px; line-height:1.7; letter-spacing:.03em; color:var(--ink, #080808); } .ds-recipe-chip .ds-icon { width:18px; height:18px; stroke-width:1.5; } .ds-recipe-chip.ds-done { color:var(--grey, #666); } .ds-recipe-chip.ds-done::after { content:''; width:7px; height:4px; border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--ink, #080808); border-left:1.5px solid var(--ink, #080808); transform:rotate(-45deg); margin-left:2px; }

components.name: Choice Row
components.description: A light rule at rest and heavier ink rule when selected.
components.css: .ds-choice { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:48px; padding:9px 7px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #e6e6e6); border-radius:0; background:none; color:var(--ink, #080808); font-family:var(--font, 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif); font-size:11px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.7; letter-spacing:.04em; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-choice:hover { border-bottom-color:var(--ink, #080808); } .ds-choice.ds-active { border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Floating Ingredient
components.description: An original line drawing above its label, with an added check.
components.html: <button class="ds-ingredient ds-added" aria-pressed="true"><svg class="ds-icon ds-icon-egg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="1" height="1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 15C20 4 12-2 6 6c-7 10-1 18 7 16 4 0 7-3 7-7Z"/></svg>Egg</button>
components.css: .ds-ingredient { position:relative; min-width:76px; min-height:76px; padding:8px 0; border:0; border-radius:0; background:none; color:var(--ink, #080808); font-family:var(--font, 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif); font-size:11px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.5; letter-spacing:.015em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-ingredient .ds-icon { display:block; width:33px; height:33px; margin:0 auto 12px; stroke-width:1.65; } .ds-ingredient:hover .ds-icon { transform:rotate(-5deg); } .ds-ingredient.ds-added::after { content:''; position:absolute; top:5px; right:7px; width:8px; height:5px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); border-left:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); transform:rotate(-45deg); } .ds-ingredient:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Order Ticket
components.description: An open order row with portrait, food drawings, and a patience meter.
components.css: .ds-ticket { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:42px 1fr; gap:14px; width:100%; max-width:350px; padding:18px 0; border:0; border-top:1px solid var(--line, #e6e6e6); background:none; color:var(--ink, #080808); text-align:left; font-family:var(--font, 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif); line-height:1.7; cursor:pointer; } .ds-ticket.ds-active { border-top-color:var(--ink, #080808); } .ds-portrait { width:42px; height:54px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-portrait svg { display:block; width:46px; height:57px; } .ds-ticket-name { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:6px; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-ticket-name > span:last-child { color:var(--grey, #666); font-size:9px; } .ds-ticket-order { display:block; font-size:11px; line-height:1.9; margin:12px 0; letter-spacing:.02em; } .ds-ticket-icons { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; } .ds-ticket-icons svg { width:30px; height:33px; } .ds-pill { font-size:10px; color:var(--grey, #666); padding:3px 0; } .ds-wait-meter { display:block; height:2px; margin-top:17px; background:var(--line, #e6e6e6); } .ds-wait-meter span { display:block; height:100%; background:#888; } .ds-ticket:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Hold Progress Control
components.description: An irregular outline for stirring or pouring with visible numerical progress.
components.css: .ds-hold { position:relative; min-height:56px; width:100%; overflow:hidden; padding:10px 15px; border:1.8px solid var(--ink, #080808); border-radius:28px 24px 27px 23px; background:var(--paper, #fff); color:var(--ink, #080808); font-family:var(--font, 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif); font-size:12px; line-height:1.7; letter-spacing:.055em; font-weight:400; touch-action:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-hold::before { content:''; position:absolute; bottom:0; left:0; width:var(--hold,0%); height:3px; background:var(--ink, #080808); } .ds-hold span { position:relative; } .ds-hold:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #080808); outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.northStar: The White Bakery, Drawn in Ink
narrative.overview:
This built world follows the user's HEYTEA reference through open white space, small widely spaced navigation, informal stroke lettering, and black profile figures. Grandma’s Bakeria keeps its own characters and bakery drawings. Warmth comes from Grandma's expression, imperfect strokes, and familiar objects: a bowl, recipe book, pastry, flyer stack, and cup of tea.

Illustration floats directly on the white page. The interface has a light hand: regular or medium local sans text, narrow rules, simple arrows, and grayscale progress. Gameplay keeps the same visual restraint while making the current recipe, ticket, station, and urgent oven state available. The rejected generic bold sans headings and gray card surfaces are outside this world.
keyCharacteristics: Original reusable vector lettering for display headings.
Solid black hair, expressive profile faces, and open outline bodies.
Loose line drawings floating in broad white space.
Small, spaced, regular navigation and readable local sans controls.
Flat white surfaces, fine separators, and explicit monochrome state feedback.

rules.name: The Paper-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: Keep large areas white. Use black for identity and action, and neutral gray for subordinate information or visible preparation state.

rules.name: The Two-Handwriting Rule
rules.body: Use the original SVG alphabet for short expressive headings, and the local sans stack for instructions, status, controls, and numbers.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Separate permanent interface regions with space and light rules. Reserve dimmed backdrops for temporary focus sheets.

dos: Do follow the user's HEYTEA reference through white space, restrained navigation, original black profile figures, and loose line artwork.
Do reuse the SVG alphabet and asset generators before adding a new visual vocabulary.
Do keep art free to float directly on white, with fine rules separating functional regions.
Do preserve important touch targets, visible focus, persistent tickets and oven alerts, and keyboard or tap alternatives.
Do pair grayscale state with words, numbers, checks, progress, or another explicit marker.
Do preserve the complete bakery game while extending this visual system.
donts: Don't restore generic bold sans hero headings or large gray card surfaces.
Don't use HEYTEA's logo, brand name, or copied artwork in Grandma’s Bakeria.
Don't add shadows, decorative gradients, textures, or broad colored surfaces to the permanent interface.
Don't require downloaded media, fonts, icon packs, sprite sheets, or browser runtime libraries; the sole permitted external image is an optional owner-supplied logo.
Don't require dragging, rotation, or decorative motion to complete an action.
